payload.name: Shared-habit confirmation to addressed person
payload.description: When a message uses 'same here, <Name>!' or 'me too, <Name>!' to confirm the addressed person shares the speaker's listed habits, extract memory candidates for both speaker and addressed person.
content: During candidate extraction, when a speaker says 'same here, <Name>!' or 'me too, <Name>!' and then lists practices/habits, create a separate state candidate with <Name> as subject containing the same listed practices, in addition to the speaker's candidate.
Only generate the addressee candidate when the sharing phrase clearly refers to the same listed practices; do not expand to other people or invent practices not explicitly named.

solves: Construction extraction omits memories for a named addressee when a speaker says 'same here, X!' or 'me too, X!' and lists practices, capturing only the speaker. Applies when a future message explicitly confirms the addressed person shares the listed durable practices: extract a candidate for both. Not applicable when agreement is about a one-off topic, or no addressee is explicitly named.
